name: copilotkit
summary: I followed the CopilotKit quickstart exactly: created the Next.js app (exit 0), installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime` (1144 packages added, exit 0), wrote all four required files (`route.ts`, `providers.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`), and set up the `.env` file. However, I could not get the app to build or serve because the sandbox's ~1.9 GB RAM is insufficient for Next.js 16 + Turbopack + CopilotKit compilation. The kernel OOM-killer repeatedly terminated the `next-server` process during compilation (dmesg showed `Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 736 (next-server)`), and `npm run build` also failed with exit 137 (SIGKILL). No HTTP endpoint ever became reachable. The only deviation from the docs was using `gpt-4o-mini` instead of the non-existent `gpt-5.4-mini` model listed in the quickstart, and adding a dummy `OPENAI_API_KEY` since no real key was exported in the environment.
